# Kernel lock ranks

Acquisition order of every static `Spinlock`, outermost first: a hart may take a ranked lock only while every ranked lock it holds is listed above it. Checked at run time in the test posture (`test-hooks`) and in host tests; dev and release kernels carry no check. Instance locks inside per-object structs are unranked.
